about: Corresponding source of the GPL FFmpeg builds the app bundles, pinned by URL, byte size and SHA-256 (same entry shape as platform/windows/build-deps.json, always with an empty 'files' list). tools/fetch_ffmpeg_source.py downloads each tarball, refuses any mismatch and names it for attaching to a GitHub release (docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md, step 'Attach the FFmpeg source'). 'builds' says which bundled binaries the source belongs to.

deps.name: ffmpeg-source-windows
deps.hash_source: computed from two identical downloads on 2026-10-09 (GitHub publishes no checksum for commit archives)
deps.builds: Windows ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe: gyan.dev essentials build 2026-05-06-git-f2e5eff3ff (platform/windows/build-deps.json)
deps.builder_source_note: https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/2026-05-06-git-f2e5eff3ff names the commit; library versions and links: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

deps.name: ffmpeg-source-macos
deps.hash_source: computed from the download; the detached signature https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz.asc verified Good against FFmpeg release signing key FCF9 86EA 15E6 E293 A564 4F10 B432 2F04 D676 58D8 on 2026-10-09
deps.builds: macOS ffmpeg and ffprobe 9.0.2: evermeet.cx (x86_64) and ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de build 1789931890_9.0.2 (arm64) (platform/macos/pyinstaller/fetch_mac_binaries.sh)
deps.builder_source_note: evermeet.cx lists the library sources on https://evermeet.cx/ffmpeg/; martin-riedl.de publishes its build script at https://git.martin-riedl.de/ffmpeg/build-script and the library versions of each build in its versions.txt
